name: C. E. Finn
bio: C. E. Finn advertised as an artist in the Cow Boy in February 1884. By March he had moved his tent gallery to Miles City.

moments.label: Moved his tent gallery to Miles City

mentions: …of those fine pictures made at the tent gallery must call at once, as I shall stay but one week longer. C. E. FINN, Artist.
…of those fine pictures made at the tent gallery must call at once, as I shall stay but one week longer. C. E. FINN, Artist.
C. E. Finn, who broke his camera so often trying to take in the gorgeousness of Joe Pennell's buckskin suit, has located his tent gallery in Miles City.
